label: 0001-saturation-regulator-hardening
author: m5306/IN27-H2
rationale: 饱和调节器 daemon 的四处硬伤：①生产库口令内联在源码（镜像入库即泄露）；②PATH 写死 /usr/bin:/bin（沙箱 shim 失效、宿主漂移即行为漂移）；③psql 调用无超时（锁等待时 daemon 挂死）；④psqlos 输出直接 int()（非数字输出即崩）。四处均由门链验证：脱敏门拦明文口令，金丝雀门验证降级路径不崩不挂。

replacements.note: 拆明文口令 + 拆死 PATH + psql 硬超时 + 解析容错 helper
数值解析统一走 _int，非数字输出不再 ValueError 崩 daemon
replacements.old:
idle = max(0, int(online) - int(busy or 0))
rel = 0
if idle >= 6 and int(held or 0) > 0:
    rel = min(idle - 4, int(held))
replacements.new:
online, busy, held = _int(online), _int(busy), _int(held)
idle = max(0, online - busy)
rel = 0
if idle >= 6 and held > 0:
    rel = min(idle - 4, held)
